info.name: SmartStay API
info.description:
SmartStay staff dashboard API (Release 1 and 2).

How to use:
1. Import this collection and the "SmartStay Local" environment, then select the environment.
2. Run "Auth > Login" (or a "Login as ..." request). The access token is saved automatically and used by every other request.
3. Access tokens last 15 minutes. Run "Auth > Refresh token" to get a new one.

Variables such as {{roomId}}, {{requestId}}, {{alertId}} are filled in by the create requests, or set them yourself in the collection variables.
Live updates use Socket.IO on the same URL with auth { token: accessToken }. Postman can test this with a new Socket.IO request.

request.description:
Used by client device APIs. Run "Rooms and devices > New webhook secret" first.
Event types: status, online, offline, fault, low_battery, unlock, dnd_on, dnd_off, presence.

Used by the hotel PMS or a bridge service. Run "PMS sync > New PMS webhook secret" first.
Types: reservation.upsert, reservation.cancelled, reservation.no_show, stay.checked_in, stay.checked_out, stay.room_moved. Each event carries the full reservation; eventId must be unique.
